name: Performance Report
query:
SELECT
  pr.employee AS `Employee`,
  pr.department AS `Department`,
  pr.period_type AS `Period`,
  pr.period_start AS `Period Start`,
  pr.period_end AS `Period End`,
  pr.target_amount AS `Target`,
  pr.hit_amount AS `Hit (Actual)`,
  pr.deviation AS `Deviation`,
  pr.variance_percent AS `Variance %`
FROM `tabPerformance Review` pr
WHERE pr.docstatus < 2
  AND (%(employee)s IS NULL OR %(employee)s = '' OR pr.employee = %(employee)s)
  AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR pr.period_start >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR pr.period_start <= %(to_date)s)
ORDER BY pr.period_start DESC
